## Send a brief {#send-a-brief}

A few lines are enough:

- What are you building or already running?
- What decision, problem, or delivery do you need help with?
- If known, what platform and timeline are involved?

[Start an email with these prompts](mailto:farrukh.nauman@inertialrange.com?subject=InertialRange%20enquiry%3A%20Project%20brief&body=What%20we%20are%20building%20or%20running%3A%0A%0AWhat%20we%20need%20help%20with%3A%0A%0APlatform%20and%20timeline%20%28if%20known%29%3A%0A%0AHow%20we%20found%20you%20%28optional%29%3A%0A){.btn .btn-primary}
[Book an intro call](https://calendar.app.google/sH8s13r8keotW6jf9){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

The email button opens a draft in your mail app. You can also write directly to **[farrukh.nauman@inertialrange.com](mailto:farrukh.nauman@inertialrange.com)**. A high-level description is enough for the first conversation.

## What happens next

I usually reply within 1–2 business days with whether the work fits, any questions needed to scope it, and a suggested next step. If there is a fit, we work toward a written proposal with deliverables, acceptance criteria, and price or rate. Work begins after we agree the scope and contract.

If you are still choosing a starting point, [compare the four offers](engage.qmd).

## Contracting details

InertialRange Labs AB is a Swedish Aktiebolag based in Linköping. Engagements can be contracted directly or through your consultant broker, with invoicing in SEK or EUR. NDAs and access requirements can be agreed during scoping.
